company.name: BukuWarung
company.shortDescription: BukuWarung is a startup focused on building bookkeeping, digital payments, and e-commerce solutions for MSMEs in Indonesia.
company.description: BukuWarung is a Y-Combinator backed technology company that is building the digital infrastructure for 60 million MSMEs in Indonesia, enabling them to efficiently manage and grow their business, starting with digital bookkeeping, online storefront & payments. BukuWarung's vision is to empower 60 million MSMEs in Indonesia to become financially aware and enable them to manage and grow their business using technology.

productsAndServices.description: A digital payment solution enabling MSMEs to collect payments from customers and make payments to suppliers or employees through various digital channels.
productsAndServices.name: Tagih dan Bayar (Collect and Pay)

productsAndServices.description: A digital product sales platform for MSMEs to earn additional income by selling prepaid and bill payment products like mobile credit, electricity tokens, and game vouchers.
productsAndServices.name: Produk Digital (PPOB)

productsAndServices.description: A unified QR code payment system allowing MSMEs to accept all non-cash payments from banks and digital wallets with same-day fund settlement.
productsAndServices.name: QRIS (Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard)

productsAndServices.description: A loan service offering unsecured business capital loans up to IDR 50 million with flexible repayment terms for MSMEs.
productsAndServices.name: Solusi Modal Usaha (Business Capital Solution)

productsAndServices.description: A pay-later payment method allowing customers to purchase stock or wholesale goods immediately and pay at a later agreed time, with funds credited instantly to the seller.
productsAndServices.name: Talangin Dulu (Buy Now, Pay Later)

productsAndServices.description: A digital bookkeeping tool for MSMEs to monitor business finances, inventory, and accounts receivable/payable efficiently and automatically.
productsAndServices.name: Pembukuan (Bookkeeping)

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $60,000,000, or 75% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,007,520 to $423,225,453, a 52.85x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
